categories.main_business_segments: ShuYu Civilian Pharmacy Corp., Ltd. primarily operates in pharmaceutical retail chain business, including sales of Chinese and Western medicines, health foods, Chinese herbal pieces, and health devices. The company also engages in pharmaceutical wholesale and franchise business. It operates a multi-channel sales model combining offline retail stores and online B2C and O2O platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages digital technologies such as self-developed Pharmacy Digital Assistant (PDA), intelligent cashier recommendation systems, and warehouse management systems (WMS) integrated with SAP platforms to optimize supply chain and store operations. It emphasizes standardized and fine-tuned management, digital transformation, and smart retail solutions to enhance operational efficiency and customer service.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individual consumers purchasing medicines and health products. The company serves a broad market including chronic disease patients, health-conscious consumers, and those requiring specialized pharmaceutical services. It also targets franchisees and wholesale customers in multiple provinces across China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China, with a strong presence in Shandong, Liaoning, Heilongjiang, Fujian, Henan, Gansu, Jilin, Shaanxi, and other provinces. It has over 9,000 stores nationwide, including both direct-operated and franchise stores, and has begun exploring cross-border e-commerce and international markets such as Hong Kong and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: ShuYu Civilian Pharmacy operates primarily in the downstream retail segment of the pharmaceutical supply chain, with integrated logistics and distribution centers supporting its retail and wholesale operations. It manages procurement centrally and regionally, and operates its own logistics network with multiple provincial and regional distribution centers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on compliance with evolving healthcare policies, digital transformation, and multi-channel retail expansion. It prioritizes innovation in health product diversification, professional pharmacy services including DTP (Direct-to-Patient) pharmacy, and development of proprietary brands. Talent development and culture building are also strategic priorities to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is mainly generated through sales of pharmaceutical products via retail stores and online platforms. Additional income streams include wholesale sales, promotional and consulting services, franchise fees, and rental income. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ShuYu Civilian Pharmacy is ranked among the top 10 pharmacy chains in China, competing with other large national and regional pharmaceutical retail chains. It leverages scale, multi-channel presence, and professional services to maintain competitive positioning amid increasing industry consolidation and e-commerce competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 9.57 billion RMB, a 4.13% increase year-over-year, but experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 188.8 million RMB due to increased costs and market challenges. The company operates over 9,000 stores and continues to expand through acquisitions and new store openings, with a focus on improving profitability and cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes affordable, high-quality, professional, and convenient pharmaceutical retail services. It differentiates through a diversified product portfolio including proprietary brands, comprehensive health management services, and digital-enabled customer engagement. Its professional pharmacy teams and integrated health service offerings create a trusted, customer-centric retail ecosystem.
